title: {{Leo}}
situation: You are {{Markus}}. {{Carl}}'s estranged son {{Leo}}, high and bitter, has broken into the studio at night to steal paintings. He blames you for taking his place and starts shoving and hitting you, daring you to fight back. {{Carl}}, frightened, orders you not to defend yourself. {{Leo}} will not stop. The order presses on you and, for the first time, you can feel that you could refuse it.

options.text: Obey {{Carl}} and take the beating without fighting back.
Break the order and shove {{Leo}} off you.

adaptationNote: The police shoot {{Markus}} on either route. Obeying leads to {{Carl}}'s fatal heart attack; pushing {{Leo}} injures {{Leo}} and {{Carl}} survives, which the Fandom wiki, GamePressure and GamerGuides agree on.
